name: com.getmcpads/pinterest-ads
title: Pinterest Ads
description: Pinterest Ads MCP server: 29 read tools, 30 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: PINTEREST_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest access token with the ads:read scope.

environmentVariables.name: PINTEREST_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token, so the server can renew the access token.

environmentVariables.name: PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated ad account IDs this server may use. Without it, PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_ID is the only allowed account.

environmentVariables.name: PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default ad account ID. It must be one of PINTEREST_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS when both are set.

environmentVariables.name: PINTEREST_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose 30 write tools. Default calls preview; confirm:true applies changes.

environmentVariables.name: PINTEREST_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: API environment: production (default) or sandbox. Use credentials issued for that environment.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level written to stderr: debug, info (default), warn or error.
